scope: Critical characterizations in Sections IV-X: sentences with a limiting marker that cite exactly one corpus work, and limiting clauses that end in a single citation inside multi-citation sentences.
method: Each claim was matched against its review card and the local full-text transcription by keyword overlap. Claims without a direct match were checked with targeted phrase searches. Source excerpts remain local and are not published.

corrections.before: Temporal scene-object graphs report corner trapping and premature termination among their physical failures.
corrections.after: Temporal scene-object graphs report corner trapping from missing depth and episodes that end with the target out of view among their physical failures.
corrections.reason: The card records episodes ending with the target out of view, not premature termination.

corrections.before: TARIC triangulates intermittent goal cues into a particle memory whose dispersion limits heading deviation during cue-free travel.
corrections.after: TARIC triangulates intermittent goal cues into a particle memory that keeps an executable goal direction during cue-free travel, although the memory drifts over long cue-free stretches.
corrections.reason: Dispersion quantifies uncertainty; no source passage states that it limits heading deviation. The authors report memory drift over long cue-free stretches.

corrections.before: provided that odometry is map-scaled and the map is static
corrections.after: provided that odometry is map-scaled and the map features still match the scene, since the map is not updated online
corrections.reason: The stated limitation is the absence of online map updates.

corrections.before: whose body-containment corridor does not enforce wheeled curvature or rolling-contact limits
corrections.after: which checks that each region can contain the robot geometry and was tested on a quadruped rather than under wheeled curvature limits
corrections.reason: The absence claim was an inference; the revised clause states what the method checks and how it was tested.

corrections.before: or assign tasks before the mission while penalizing capability shortfall
corrections.after: or fix a robust task schedule before the mission under uncertain agent capabilities
corrections.reason: The source formulates a robust pre-mission schedule under capability uncertainty; a shortfall penalty is not stated.

claims.claim: Switch-SLAM adds visual constraints only when normalized Hessian eigenvalues indicate LiDAR degeneracy and falls back to inertial propagation when both modalities fail .

Teammates provide another source, as RaLI-Multi corrects LiDAR--inertial drift along the detected degenerate direction with inter-vehicle UWB ranges, provided that at least one horizontal direction remains well constrained .
Contact uncertainty can also be estimated explicitly, as when a tire-model observer fuses wheel-level velocities by covariance intersection and excludes inconsistent wheels .
Time-of-flight (ToF)--wheel odometry inflates process covariance only along the remainder that differential-drive motion cannot explain .
IL-LIO learns point-to-voxel residuals and uncertainty for nonplanar geometry , although learned residual variance is not an independently calibrated integrity bound.
DynoSAM instead estimates rigid-object motion in world-centric factor graphs through full-batch optimization without loop closure .
For automotive radar, multi-session loop verification and a temporal occupancy grid retain persistent points for later localization under a planar-trajectory assumption .
Orchard trunk maps suppress seasonal foliage at the price of making global recovery depend on adequate trunk support .

CMRNext casts camera-to-LiDAR matching as optical flow followed by perspective-n-point estimation and transfers across camera setups, although it is trained on driving data, does not yet run in real time, and receives an initial pose for every frame .

OMCL scores Monte Carlo hypotheses with open-vocabulary features ray-cast from a three-dimensional map and can initialize from a language description, provided that odometry is map-scaled and the map features still match the scene, since the map is not updated online .
Robot-mounted lighting in LUCID improves visual appearance without necessarily improving odometry .
A risk-aware learner labels traversed footprints and weak obstacles before predicting unvisited cells, with predictions evaluated only on manually driven recordings .
An anisotropic explorer penalizes motion by slope and travel direction with a quasi-static Euler Cost that omits slip and suspension transients .
SPARTA predicts angle-conditioned risk distributions as reusable Fourier functions from a fully observed prior point cloud .

A visual-foundation-model approach learns cost, speed, and novelty maps from expert driving for model predictive path integral (MPPI) control, with field trials in which operator corrections expose residual failures that offline trajectory agreement conceals .
Potential-field MPC integrates frontier and unknown-space costs on a six-wheel skid-steer robot, although without systematic baselines .

SCOPE predicts future occupancy-grid distributions from robot motion, tracked objects, and a local static map and inserts their mean and uncertainty into the costmaps of existing planners, with distillation enabling embedded inference .

Homotopy-driven MPC optimizes distinct trajectory classes in parallel from externally tracked poses , a form of candidate diversity that reduces local inconsistency without compensating for a missed pedestrian or an incorrect interaction model.

HEIGHT separates pedestrians from static obstacles in a heterogeneous spatio-temporal graph and transfers from a low-fidelity simulator to four everyday environments, although its deployed obstacle input assumes a map and reliable localization .
A rough-terrain sim-to-real policy trained with terrain scaling and pose noise still fails under vibration and inaccurate reconstructed geometry .
Lifelong navigation, in turn, learns only where an initial DWA policy supplies useful experience .
A LiDAR-based CBF safety filter fits a GP to current obstacle edges and uses its mean and gradient in a quadratic program, with an invariance argument that excludes the GP variance .
Safe Horizon MPC samples obstacle trajectories, applies a plan only after slack and support checks, and otherwise decelerates .
MonoMPC learns the distribution of minimum clearance for candidate controls from monocular depth, without temporal memory, and minimizes a distribution-based risk .
OpenIN updates the existence confidence of a carrier--object pair when an expected object is not observed .

Such updates must distinguish removal from occlusion or poor depth. osmAG-LLM instead assumes from the outset that objects move, keeping a lightweight text-based area graph for context, asking a language model for likely locations, and confirming targets by online detection .
Multimodal spatial language maps add image and audio features to an offline map, although a remembered sound marks where it was heard rather than its source .
Temporal scene-object graphs report corner trapping from missing depth and episodes that end with the target out of view among their physical failures .

Sem-NaVAE applies the same generate-and-select structure without a map, scoring conditional variational autoencoder (VAE) proposals with lightweight open-vocabulary segmentation and reporting 90\% success on 120--240\,m campus and park routes with few repetitions per route .
VAMOS adds an embodiment filter, in which a per-robot affordance model trained in simulation re-ranks the image-space paths proposed by a VLM planner .
Safe-VLN masks predicted waypoints with simulated occupancy and selects a new waypoint after a collision occurs .
VAMOS plans at 1\,Hz on a laptop GPU , a rate that a fast local controller can bridge only while it retains a valid action.

Multi-Proxy combines lightweight descriptors for progressive loop detection with asynchronous ADMM pose-graph optimization and continues under simulated packet loss and latency, where a two-stage Gauss--Seidel baseline fails to converge, provided that front-end odometry stays stable .

MEF-Explore derives rendezvous from entropy fields and assumes that low-rate position exchange is always available, exploring 21.32\% faster with a 16.67\% higher success rate than the baseline on three TurtleBot2 robots .

Correlation-aware collaboration, evaluated on recorded road-vehicle data, exchanges states, covariances, and cross-covariances of common landmarks before Kullback--Leibler averaging and Schmidt--Kalman updates .
Failure-aware target tracking fuses target estimates by covariance intersection after reconnection and lets a permanently isolated aerial tracker signal a hazard .
Kinematics-based detection compares position, angular velocity, and acceleration through transport relations, with faults injected into recorded rover data .
Integrity analysis for extended Kalman filter (EKF) SLAM accumulates landmark fault risk, although its recorded example crosses the threshold only after localization fails .
A prior-line-map protection level predicts estimation error, with operational alerting left for future work .
PAAD predicts anomalies along a planned path on field recordings in which people reposition the robot after failures .

RADIUM moves failure prediction before deployment by sampling environment parameters from a distribution conditioned on failure and repairs the policy on the discovered cases, reporting up to five times higher robustness for a repaired vision-in-the-loop policy on a 1/10-scale car .

In the estimator, fault-tolerant prior-map collaboration excludes faulty observations, inflates faulty-landmark covariance, and specifies reinitialization for odometry faults without evaluating an executed reset .
At the planning level, a GP predictor of safe-corridor optimizer failure triggers a stop--reposition--resume sequence .

Help Me Through learns viewpoint actions from about 50\,h of human demonstrations, or 20\,h followed by online fine-tuning, to keep monocular SLAM tracking through texture-poor transitions, with a physical test that runs the policy on live images while a person teleoperates path planning .
CODEI selects bodies, sensors, algorithms, and computing units from catalogs by coupling simulated planner queries to characterized perception errors .
A ten-home assistive deployment combines docking rules, cloud orchestration, and remote supervision, with internet problems and localization failures among the causes of interruption .

A cloud--edge system offloads mapping and trajectory generation over 5G while keeping MPC tracking and collision avoidance on Jetson-equipped Ackermann robots, falling back to a leader-based local network .
Counterfactual replay selects among adapting policies at the cost of between-trial computation .
The step to hardware can itself change the result, as the drop in success of terrain-adaptive MPC between simulation and outdoor trials shows .
Spatiotemporal-tube guarantees likewise assume bounded disturbances and terminal separation without explicit input limits .
Across ten homes, the assistive-robot study records 1539 service requests, of which 1130 succeeded, 177 failed, and 232 were not performed .
Some studies remove scenarios before reporting, as when the CENTAURO study discards infeasible or slowly planned scenarios .
A trial repeated after failed relocalization differs from recovery within the original attempt.
Completion after temporal-logic relaxation must likewise name the requirements that were changed.
DMSA processes data at 1.5--4 times the recording duration and distinguishes unsupported sensor adaptations from failed runs .

A study of LiDAR--inertial non-reproducibility repeats each experiment 30 times after controlling subscribers and buffering , showing that repeated playback characterizes implementation variability rather than variation across missions.
Wheel--inertial odometry with a ground-manifold prior offers an interoceptive fallback whose drift grows without external correction .
In the team-level analogue, Co-NavGPT executes semantic frontier assignments geometrically with perception and planning on a workstation .
SocialNav-SUB indicates that incorrect reasoning, and not only unavailable or delayed responses, requires explicit testing .

Disconnection, Reconnection, and Corrupted Shared Information Reconnection mechanisms exist for particular shared quantities, such as the target estimates that failure-aware aerial tracking fuses after a link returns .
Simulation-based failure prediction can repair policies before deployment, although only for the failures that the simulator models .
